content.title: About
content.content: Pre‑gelatinized corn flour is a dry starch derived from corn that has been heat‑treated so it can instantly dissolve in cold liquids without prior heating. It is widely used in the food industry and home cooking as a thickener, stabilizer, and texture enhancer.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Pre‑gelatinized corn flour swells instantly in cold liquids, making it convenient for sauces and desserts.
It is gluten‑free, suitable for gluten‑free diets.
Corn is one of the most cultivated cereal crops worldwide, and its flour is used in over 30 countries.
The pre‑gelatinization process improves shelf‑life stability and reduces clumping.
It is commonly found in dairy‑free yogurts, ice creams, and ready‑to‑mix baking blends.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: Provides slowly digestible carbs that help maintain steady energy levels.

items.title: Rich in dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber supports healthy digestion and promotes satiety.

items.title: Gluten‑free
items.content: Safe for individuals with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Supplies thiamine, niacin, and folate, which are important for metabolism.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Compared with wheat flour, it contains less fat, making it lighter for diet‑focused meals.

items.title: Corn allergy
items.content: A small percentage of people may experience allergic reactions to corn products.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Can cause rapid blood‑sugar spikes, so people with diabetes should use it in moderation.

items.title: Acrylamide formation on high‑heat cooking
items.content: When exposed to very high temperatures (frying, baking), acrylamide may form, a potential toxin.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Add pre‑gelatinized corn flour to cold sauces, soups, smoothies, dessert creams, and doughs without pre‑heating. It works well in gluten‑free baking, breading, and thickening purees.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct light. For long‑term storage, refrigerate to prevent moisture absorption and clumping.
